description_text:
The New York City Human Resources Administration, through its Office of HIV/AIDS Services Administration intends to renew one (1) contract with the contractor listed below for the Provision of Non-Emergency Permanent Supportive Congregate Housing under NY/NY III funded with NY 15/15 (30 units).

Unique People Services Inc.

201 East Burnside Avenue

Bronx, NY 10457

EPIN: 06923P8003KXLR001

The renewal term of the contract will be from 07/01/2027  06/30/2032. Anyone who has comments on the performance of the contractor, or the proposed renewal of the contracts may contact Jacquelin Dudley at (929) 252-2872. This notice is for informational purposes only.
